summary: Comprehensive testing of F&O Export Results feature - all 11 acceptance criteria verified using API route mocking with mock fnoData. All tests passed: export button visibility, dropdown with 3 options (CSV/XLS/JPG), outside-click close, column calculations, deduplication, hidden JPG table, and all 3 export downloads triggered successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: T1% and T2% columns in CSV/XLS exports are string values (e.g. '28.00%') not numeric. In Excel, this means percentage columns won't sort numerically. Low priority since it's display-only.
NOTE: The fno-export-btn is conditionally rendered only when fnoData is not null - this is correct behavior confirmed in testing.
NOTE: The close-on-outside-click handler (useEffect on exportMenuOpen) checks both fno-export-btn and fno-export-menu data-testids - correctly prevents false closes.
seed_data_creation: Used API route mocking (page.route) to inject mock fnoData without real Kite connection. Login used: @shish123
context_for_next_testing_agent: F&O Export feature fully tested and working. Test approach: login as @shish123, navigate to F&O page, intercept **/api/fno/generate route with mock data containing all required projection fields (non_directional_strategies, with_consolidated_report, without_consolidated_report). Export button visible only after data loads. All 3 export formats (CSV/XLS/JPG) trigger file downloads. Columns and calculations all verified.
